description:
Geonha desires an ordinary life, one that goes unnoticed. Yet he's already in his fourth year working at an adult magazine publisher.
Moreover, his nickname within the company is already "Dildo Master" (a secret from him).  

Living a life completely at odds with his own principles, Geonha is now asked to write a 'Sex Experience' column.
Blinded by the prospect of an upcoming salary negotiation, Geonha accepts. And the first place he goes is... a gay bar?!

"Since I'm writing it anyway, might as well make it fresh and stimulating, right?"
